name: Suou
source:
The adopted son of the current supreme god of the divine realm.
His power is said to be equal to that of the Twelve Divine Generals, who are second only to the supreme god in power, and he is the next in line to lead the divine realm.
He spends his days in the divine realm as a strong candidate for the throne.
However, he himself is completely indifferent to such things and has a straightforward side, always following his own path.
He seems to be very fond of the title "Prince of the Divine Realm,"
He doesn't spend much time in the divine realm; he prefers to visit the human world.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/176841/?gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
